name: Ciprofloxacin and tizanidine are contraindicated
actions: Do not coadminister ciprofloxacin and tizanidine; use an alternative.

rationale: The labeled combination is contraindicated due to hypotension and sedation.

explanation_template: Ciprofloxacin inhibits tizanidine metabolism through CYP1A2. This combination is contraindicated because tizanidine exposure can rise markedly, causing hypotension and sedation.

references.source: DailyMed, Ciprofloxacin Tablets, Contraindications and Drug Interactions
references.citation: Concomitant ciprofloxacin and tizanidine is contraindicated.
